blurb: A caller supplies a message's arguments by name, so every locale's template for a code must use the same set of `{name}` placeholders as the reference locale's. A translation that renames, drops or adds one would ask for an argument the caller never passes. Order is free: translations may reorder placeholders to suit their grammar. Rename the placeholder to match the reference. A placeholder of the right name but a different ICU kind is `bynk.messages.format_mismatch`.
summary: A locale's template for a code uses a different set of `{name}` placeholders than the reference locale's.
